payload.comment:
Profiling stage is internally consistent and thorough. Structured data correctly reports image_shape_hwc=[28,28,3], full-dataset usage (profiled_fraction=1.0, subsampled=false), zero duplicates, zero blank images, and complete provenance (archive_md5 + per-split sha256 hashes). Train/val near-identical proportions (max Δ<0.001) confirm a random single-site split, and the test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, external center) is properly flagged.

The test-set distribution shift is substantial and well-documented: adipose ×1.79, normal colon mucosa ×1.62, debris ×0.41, stroma ×0.56, smooth muscle ×0.61 relative to train. Test imbalance ratio (3.95) is more than double train (1.63). Small per-class test counts (debris n=339, stroma n=421, smooth muscle n=592) will make per-class metrics noisy. These are inherent dataset characteristics, not pipeline defects, and are correctly surfaced.

Minor issues noted:
1. The LLM-generated ambiguity_risks narrative references '96×96 patch resolution' in two places, but the actual image shape is 28×28×3 (correctly stated in structured fields). This is a factual error in the narrative text only; it does not affect any computed value or downstream data path, but could mislead a reader who relies on the prose.
2. llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama), so the exact model weights are not content-hashed. This limits bit-level reproducibility of any LLM-dependent step but does not affect the deterministic profiling computations.
3. Label-ambiguity concerns (debris vs mucus vs background; stroma vs smooth muscle at 28×28) are legitimate dataset limitations, not pipeline errors. They are appropriately flagged for downstream evaluation design (e.g., macro-averaged metrics, per-class confidence intervals).

No deterministic findings were raised. All schema versions are 1.0. Package versions, seed (47), and code hash are recorded. The profiling artefact is complete and ready to proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: Narrative text in ambiguity_risks references '96×96 patch resolution' but actual image shape is 28×28×3; factual inconsistency in LLM-generated prose only, structured data is correct.
llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama); exact model weights not pinned by content hash, limiting full reproducibility of LLM-dependent steps.

Test-set class distribution deviates substantially from train/val (adipose ×1.79, debris ×0.41, stroma ×0.56); per-class test metrics for debris (n=339), stroma (n=421), smooth muscle (n=592) will be statistically noisy.
Label semantics for 'debris', 'background', and 'cancer-associated stroma' may differ across annotation sites; no inter-annotator agreement evidence for the external center.
